messages.content: Hi Grace, it's Luis. Your new bathroom fan came in, I can install it Saturday the 16th around 10.
That works, thank you. I'll be home from 9:30 on, just buzz 3B when you get here.
All done. New fan is in and running quiet, I tested it 15 minutes. Took the old one with me.
Thank you Luis, it's already so much quieter in there. I'll keep your number for the next project 😊
Hi Luis, quick question. The fan kicked on by itself during my shower this morning, is it supposed to do that?
Yes, that's the humidity sensor. Leave the wall switch on and it runs when it gets steamy, then shuts off once the air clears
Mystery solved, thank you! And no foggy mirror this morning, so it's earning its keep
Glad to hear it. If it ever runs longer than you like, there's a little dial behind the grille to adjust it 👍
Hi Luis! Filing the receipt from last Saturday and all it says is 'fan job.' Can you text me what it covered? I'm labeling it bathroom exhaust fan replacement, 3B
Sure, sorry about that. It covered the new fan with the humidity sensor, a new duct connector and foil tape, install labor, and hauling the old one away
That's all I needed, thank you! Have a good long weekend
Happy birthday Hannah!! Hope today gives you a slow morning and a really good dinner ❤️
thank youuu!! 38 feels fake. miss you so much, we're way overdue for a real phone call
So overdue. I'm around most weekends in July, pick a Saturday afternoon and I'll call you.
deal!! I'll text you once July settles down a little. talk soon
ok july is never going to settle down so I'm just picking a date lol. saturdays are packed for me, could you do sunday the 19th at 2? facetime?
Sunday the 19th at 2 works! FaceTime is in my calendar 😊 Off to finish a quiche for Father's Day brunch
that hour went by WAY too fast 😭 drive safe to your cookout and say hi to your parents for me
It really did! Made it to Naperville only a little late, and my parents say hi back 😊 So good to see your face
ok also you never told me how the father's day quiche turned out!! I need that recipe
Dad went back for thirds, so I'm calling it a win 😊 Store-bought crust, 4 eggs, 1 cup half and half, 1 cup gruyère, sautéed leeks + bacon. 375° for about 40 min, until the middle barely jiggles
made your quiche for a friend's brunch today and people kept asking for the recipe. I said old family secret and changed the subject 🤫
Ha! At this point it basically is one 😊 Did the middle do the jiggle?
perfect jiggle. apparently I'm a quiche person now 😌
Summer track Tuesdays start next week! 6:30 at the Winnemac track, which is basically your backyard 😄 Can I put you down?
Ha, it really is. But I already do my Tuesday run at 6:15am and intervals that night would wreck me. Send me the workouts though?
Finally remembering to send this: tonight was 8x400 at 5K effort with a 200m jog between. 14 of us showed up! Steal it for a morning sometime 😉
Track's on tonight if you can sneak away! Also a few of us are doing an easy 8 from Montrose on Saturday morning if you're around
Sorry, just seeing this! Tuesday was book club. Is Saturday still on? I'd love to join
Yes! 7am at Montrose Harbor by the bait shop, up to Hollywood Beach and back. Pace around 9:30
Perfect, I'm in. Last Saturday's 10 miler is still in my legs, so 9:30s sound great. Selmarie after?
Always. Bring water, the harbor fountain was off last week and it's supposed to be sticky. See you at 7!

Hang onto it if you don't mind! The last one left by the mailboxes went missing for two days. I'll knock around 6:30.
No problem, I'm in all night. Fair warning, it's heavier than it looks.
Ha, that'd be the water filters. Sorry! See you in a bit.
Heads up, yard crew is doing leaves Thursday morning. They asked for the side gate unlocked and the bins pulled away from the fence.
Got it, ours go out to the curb Wednesday night anyway. Is the latch still sticking? Had to hip-check it yesterday.
Still sticking. I'll prop it with the brick Thursday so they're not fighting it, and I'll text maintenance about it again.
Perfect, thank you. Different thing: the light over the front steps was out when I got home last night. Bulb or that timer box in the hall?
Timer I think. It's been wonky since the power blipped last week. I can reset it tonight unless you know the trick.
No trick, just hold the little button on the side till it blinks, then set the time. Thanks for dealing with it!
Hey Dana, need a CPE rec. Anything good on lease accounting coming up? We're reworking the trailer lease schedule at Lakeshore Freight before audit fieldwork.
Yes actually. Ledgerline has a live ASC 842 webinar today at 1, about 2 hours. Covers modifications, remeasurements and embedded leases, so probably most of your headache.
Today works. Is it group internet or self-study? I'm maxed out on self-study hours this cycle.
Group internet. Polling questions every 20 min or so, so no leaving it running behind workpapers like we did every busy season 😅
Ha, guilty. Just registered.
Webinar was worth it, and yes, I answered every polling question. The yard tractor example on the short-term exemption settled a debate my team's been having for two weeks.
Nice! Put the policy election in a memo before fieldwork. Back on our engagements that was the first thing we'd ask for, and it cuts the back-and-forth way down.
Drafting it now. Want it through internal review before the PBC list shows up in early November.
Smart. An election nobody wrote down is exactly how you end up with a management letter comment.
Different question, I still owe 4 ethics hours by Dec 31. Know one that isn't 4 hours of someone reading the AICPA Code out loud?
Ha, yes. The case-based one I took in September was genuinely good, real scenarios and decent discussion. There's still a Dec 3 session.
Found it and signed up for the 3rd. Thanks Dana, you're still my CPE oracle.
Also, lunch sometime in November? Any Friday works for me.
Friday 11/20 at Revival? My treat for the webinar tip 😊
Perfect, see you then.
Hi Grace, it's Tara from Marketplace. Texting is easier for me than Messenger. The Trek hybrid is still available if you want to come try it!
Hi Tara, thanks! Is it a small frame? I could come by tomorrow around 5:30 after work and take it around the block first
It's a small, and it fit me well at 5'3. Tomorrow at 5:30 works. I'll have it out front by the steps, just ring the bell. $175, Venmo is fine
Hi Grace! It's Tara, who sold you the Trek. I was cleaning out the garage and found the front and rear lights I took off it before you picked it up. Want them? Free, they just need new batteries
Hi Tara! Sorry for the slow reply, it's month-end at work. Yes please, perfect timing now that it's dark by 6:30. Could I swing by Thursday after work?
Thursday works! I'll leave them in a bag on the porch rail, no need to ring the bell
Thank you! The Trek has been great btw. It lived on an indoor trainer for most of August, so it earned its keep
Ha, love that it got so much use 🚲

Thanks Gerald 👍
Heat's on! The radiator in my bedroom is clanking like a drum set though
same lol. Gerald do we need to bleed them agian?

The best fix is a tech visit to check the line into your unit. The earliest openings are Sat 8/8, 8 to 10 AM or 10 AM to 12 PM. Which works better?

Haha thank you for answering! You seem really kind. I don't know many people here yet. Are you in New York too?

Thanks! I'll have to skip the shakeout, work is nuts this week. If I can't get there by 7 on Friday, can my friend Jess pick up my bib? She's running it too.
Sorry, busy afternoon here! Yes, that's fine. She'll just need a photo of your ID and your confirmation email.

omg mom one month thats nothing
ur basically retired already teh pharmacy is gonna fall apart without u lol

31 years is amazing, Mom. Your team is going to miss you so much.

She is going to reorganize the base mint.
I am not! Maybe the hall closet. The basement can wait until spring.
lol dad
for real tho what r u gonna do the first week
Sleep in, walk the Riverwalk every morning, and finally read the books piled on my nightstand. Then I will figure out the rest 😊
Dinner on the 12th. The four of us.
ya dont make plans that night mom were taking u out
You don't need to do anything for me. But dinner together sounds lovely. Nothing fancy please 🙏

chairs again i assume lol

and gracie is on pies obviously

Pecan.
pumpkin or i riot 🙃

Of course! Pumpkin and pecan, plus two dozen rolls from Café Selmarie. I'll bake Wednesday night ❤️
Wonderful. Kevin, please bring the card table too. Grace's pies need their own table 😊 Love, Mom
ya i can grab the card table its in my basement
ill put it all on teh list tmrw
Cranberry sauce is mine. From the can.
The can with the ridges is tradition 😊 I'll add my pies and rolls to the family list tonight.
Thank you all. I will put the turkey on the list after I call the store this week. Love, Mom 😊
Sounds perfect, Mom ❤️
Hi you two, is dinner still 7:30 on the 12th?
My team is doing a cake for me at 3 that afternoon, so I want to leave time to come home and change first 😊
Yes.
I will drive us.

They already are! Two of the techs cried when I cleaned out my top drawer on Friday.
What should I wear? Since it is a room I suppose my work cardigan will not do 😊
Wear whatever you feel good in. The green blouse always looks so nice on you ❤️
The green one it is. Thank you both 😊
Hi Grace, I forgot to tell you. The turkey is ordered from Casey's Foods, 18 pounds, fresh. We pick it up Wednesday the 25th. Dad says it is too big. Love, Mom 😊

Kevin eats for three people. And everyone wants leftovers.

Brine.

Garage.

The big cooler with ice works too. That's what we did two years ago and it came out perfect 😊
